symptom: Breaker closing spring does not charge
Partial discharge alarm raised in switchgear panel
root_cause: Moisture condensed because the anti-condensation heater was switched off
action: Switch the heater back on and clean the insulators

symptom: Partial discharge detected at cable termination
root_cause: Poor workmanship at the cable termination

symptom: Protection relay trips with no system fault
root_cause: CT wired with reversed polarity or wrong relay setting
action: Correct the CT wiring and relay settings

root_cause: Core clamping has loosened or load has high harmonics
action: Re-tighten the core clamping and add a harmonic filter

root_cause: Air left inside after oil filling
action: Bleed air from the Buchholz relay and keep monitoring
Return to factory for repair under warranty

root_cause: Off-circuit tap changer left at wrong position
action: De-energise and set the correct tap position
